officialSource.signatureHandling: Fjord compresses unsigned raw bytes then adds68 signature bytes once; caller must not append fake signature or supply signed transaction.

deployedIdentity.note: Read deployed implementation identity and source registry results. Source registry metadata must match deployed runtime before describing source as verified.

quoteSemantics.input: ethers.Transaction.unsignedSerialized, including typed envelope where applicable
quoteSemantics.signaturePadding: Do not add signatures or manual padding. Verified Fjord runtime applies fastLZ(unsignedRaw).length + 68 internally.
quoteSemantics.fee: Oracle getL1Fee returns L1 posting fee in native BNB wei; add execution gasUsed * effectiveGasPrice once.
quoteSemantics.scenario: Local unsigned request structure uses local/fake addresses and nonces; live bid must be supplied as an explicit scenario.
quoteSemantics.confidence: Exact standard Fjord implementation runtime hash matched to official derivation spec.
